hero.headline: Business Strategy Officer
hero.sub: We are hiring a Business Strategy Officer for our consulting team in Wuse Zone 5, Abuja. Hybrid · ₦100,000/month.

entries.title: 2 Years' Experience in Business Development, Consulting or HR

lists.heading: Job Description
items: Analyse client businesses and recommend practical strategy, structure and growth plans.
Support business development by preparing proposals and presentations and following up on opportunities.
Support HR and organisational design projects for clients and report progress to the team.

lists.heading: Benefits
items: Hands-on consulting experience with Nigerian businesses.
